body:
**[comments] Rule 3, the one-line contract: cut**

The requires clause (is_const_v<T> and U == remove_const_t<T>) states the conversion direction, and the body data_(other.data_) states that conversion copies the pointer. The lifetime rule is carried by TRON(this_lifetimebound) and the deleted rvalue as_view() overloads of the owner, and Rule 3 prefers the attribute over a comment.

Proposed: cut the comment.
